scope: Constructed planted & clean controls; not population accuracy or production admission

source.bytes:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: scanner-fixture
spec:
  hostNetwork: false
  hostPID: false
  hostIPC: false
  securityContext:
    runAsNonRoot: true
  containers:
    - name: app
      image: example.invalid/app@sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
      securityContext:
        privileged: true
        allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
        readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
        runAsNonRoot: true

processTree.detail: normal exit: process-group cleanup; term_errno=Some(3), kill_errno=None, post_reap_probe_errno=None, post_reap_group_absent=None

ownedConfig.bytes:
checks:
  doNotAutoAddDefaults: true
  include:
    - privileged-container
    - privilege-escalation-container
    - host-network
    - host-pid
    - host-ipc
    - sensitive-host-mounts
    - wildcard-in-rules
    - cluster-admin-role-binding
    - writable-host-mount
    - unsafe-proc-mount
    - run-as-non-root
    - no-read-only-root-fs

candidates.claim: container "app" is Privileged hence allows privilege escalation.
candidates.title: container "app" is Privileged hence allows privilege escalation.

Diagnostic.Message: container "app" is Privileged hence allows privilege escalation.

raw.Remediation: Ensure containers do not allow privilege escalation by setting allowPrivilegeEscalation=false, privileged=false and removing CAP_SYS_ADMIN capability. See https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/security-context/ for more details.
Do not run your container as privileged unless it is required.
